verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs recommend restricted API keys (RAKs) for any key given to an AI agent and use RAK permissions to limit what the agent can do in the account. Per-resource scoping is shown concretely: Product Catalog Imports write is required, or requests return a 403. Shared payment tokens add scoped, expiring, revocable payment credentials with currency, max-amount and expiry limits, and the hosted MCP server is OAuth-gated, which a runtime probe confirms. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of RAK permission granularity and key lifecycle (expiry, rotation, auditing) for agent keys, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of RAK scoping in agent use.
